description: This file defines and exports a function to fetch active user trends based on a specified time bucket ('daily', 'weekly', 'monthly') and optional parameters. It acts as a wrapper around an API call, mapping UI granularity options to backend API parameters.

methods.name: fetchActiveUsersByBucket(bucket, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches user activity trend data based on specified time granularity ('daily', 'weekly', 'monthly') and optional filtering parameters.
